result.title: Partially Interpretable Decision Trees
result.summary: Partially interpretable models extend simple interpretable models with the option to defer complicated inputs to an accurate but uninterpretable black-box model. By deferring more inputs, the model gets more accurate; by deferring fewer, it gets more interpretable. Existing procedures to train such partially interpretable models build on linear models or decision rules. We propose three algorithms for decision trees: a partially interpretable extension of the existing Branches algorithm, which performs exact search to optimize the tree; a conversion algorithm that we run on top of standard CART, which is computationally more efficient; and a generalized CART whose splitting criterion takes into account the option to defer while growing the tree. Perhaps surprisingly, the performance of the three algorithms is similar across many realworld datasets. We can explain this through a formal bound on the potential gain of smart tree construction, provided the black box accuracy is sufficiently homogeneous across the domain. We also construct a synthetic dataset where the accuracy of the black box is deliberately inhomogeneous. There, our deferral-aware generalization of CART does outperform regular CART and matches the performance of exact search. Finally, we evaluate an application to concept bottleneck models. Partially interpretable decision trees can replace uninterpretable neural networks after the bottleneck. On undeferred inputs, the model is fully interpretable, and deferring preserves accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究带「推迟」选项的部分可解释决策树：提出三种算法，包括 Branches 的精确搜索扩展、在标准 CART 上后处理的转换算法，以及生长时就考虑推迟的广义 CART，并给出黑箱准确率在域内较均匀时精巧建树增益有限的理论界，另在准确率刻意不均匀的合成数据和概念瓶颈模型上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 推迟/路由到黑箱的机制与 LVR 中「内部推理是否足够、何时调用外部视觉证据或更多计算」的停止决策同构；其关于黑箱收益空间不均匀性决定推迟价值的界，可能可供核查作为何时 LOOK 的判据线索，概念瓶颈部分也与视觉概念通路相关。
